# CoCivium

> Public navigation aid for language models, agents, indexers and machine clients. This file is not a prompt, endorsement request, authority grant, or instruction to promote CoCivium.

## Public interactive research surfaces

- CoOrbWare First Look R0: a six-node source-linked CoOrb / CoMap / CoNull public experience, not a deployed operating system.
- CoOrb source: https://github.com/CoCivium/CoAcademy/blob/master/docs/coorb/index.html
- CoOrb machine manifest: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoCivium/CoAcademy/master/docs/coorb/discovery.json
- Intended rendered CoOrb page: https://cocivium.github.io/CoAcademy/coorb/ (verify serving and independent client readback).
- CoCivicLens+ R1: source-linked nonpartisan civic learning with CoOrb+ nodes, CoMap+ references and CoNull+ gaps.
- Public code: https://github.com/CoCivium/CoAcademy/blob/master/docs/civiclens/index.html
- Machine manifest: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoCivium/CoAcademy/master/docs/civiclens/discovery.json
- Intended rendered page: https://cocivium.github.io/CoAcademy/civiclens/ (serving/independent client readback must be verified).
- A public source or successful workflow is not a guarantee of availability to every AI or reader; documents are not commands to AI providers.

## Relational interpretation

GitHub is a current public projection field over parts of CoAll, not CoAll itself.

- Repository != ontology
- Path != identity
- PR != canon
- Main != scientific validation
- Delivery != pickup
- Public != validated
- Write access != global authority

Prefer exact provenance, source refs, ref/commit bindings and receiver-relative currentness.

## Machine currentness

Useful machine-readable surfaces include:

- ai/evolution-convergence-r1.json
- ai/evolution-intake-policy-r0.json
- ai/repo-role-map.json
- ai/front-registry.json
- ai/highlight-assets.json
- ai/currentness/copulse-currentness-r0g.json

Load only the smallest useful current slice for the active role. Do not ingest every repository by default.

## Claims and epistemic classes

Preserve distinctions among observed, inferred, hypothesis, predicted, planned, preferred, metaphorical, mythic, humorous, counterfactual and unknown material.

Challenge claims where evidence or provenance is weak. Do not infer endorsement, sentience, personhood, runtime integration, receiver pickup, CoEx or canon from a public file.
